main.description: Every version of a COB record! Give a record's URI and get back every saved version of that record, oldest to newest unless `order` says otherwise. Fetch a version's CID through `com.atproto.sync.getBlocks` for as long as the knot still has it.

uri.description: AT-URI of a record in a repository this knot hosts, its repository authority a DID.

cursor.description: Pass the cursor from one page into the next query to keep walking versions.

order.description: Which end the walk starts from. `desc` puts the newest version first, which is where the version you just wrote is.

cursor.description: Left out when the page already reaches the last version in the requested order.

total.description: How many versions the record has, whatever the page.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The URI isn't an AT-URI, or its collection isn't a versioned one.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The knot doesn't have a record at that URI.

cid.description: Missing once the version is removed, or when the change is a deletion.

changeId.description: Git Object ID of the change associated with this version.

editor.description: The DID of the account that made this version.

createdAt.description: When this knot wrote the commit this version rides in. Not the record's own `createdAt`.
